fallos_mitigaciones: Core vulnerability chain (per document): (1) fake cryptographic verification -- signature check only tests string length==64 instead of real Ed25519 verification; (2) fabricated CIDs generated on network-resolution failure so predetermined content is served even offline; (3) hardcoded 'genesis' registry fallback with a RANDOM always-passing signature; (4) silent trust degradation -- verification failure only logs a warning and CONTINUES (exit code 0); (5) automatic hook execution (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit) fetches/applies patterns without explicit user action.
